{{Quote|Chancellor Saresh also refused to discuss surrender, but the Republic Senate managed to overrule her. A cadre of Senators negotiated their own cease-fire terms. All of those Senators have since been disgraced or dismissed. I'm sure you can imagine the likely culprit.|Lana Beniko|<ref name="Chapter 4" />}}
A '''treaty''' was negotiated between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Eternal Empire]] by a group of [[Senator/Legends|Senators]] during the [[Eternal Empire conquest|Eternal Empire's conquest]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The treaty ended the Eternal Empire's assault upon the Republic, but forced the Republic to begin paying a heavy tribute of raw materials and resources, as well as an arms limitation statute that the Republic broke in secret. The Senators who negotiated the cease-fire did so when the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] overruled [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Leontyne Saresh]], though Saresh arranged for the disgrace or dismissal of the Senators who were involved in the aftermath.<ref name="Chapter 4" />

The treaty would become void when the [[Eternal Alliance]] absorbed the Eternal Empire and freed the Republic from these terms.
